paragraphs: He is mentioned in Avodah Zarah 69a and Zevachim 39a, raising objections to Ravina.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied heading abbreviates the title as ר׳. Both William Davidson digital texts, Avodah Zarah 69a and Zevachim 39a, fully write Rav Tachlifa (רב תחליפא), supporting Rav here.

Both saved Davidson passages fully write Rav Tachlifa: Avodah Zarah69a has bar Giza and Zevachim39a bar Gaza. Both address Ravina with challenges. The heading’s alternative spellings and source abbreviation are preserved; the older Rabbi expansion is superseded by these exact Rav witnesses.
